bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for American Hairless Terriers: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the American Hairless Terrier series closes at about 16 weeks.

Size class small does not invent new viruses for the American Hairless Terrier, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag patellar luxation at American Hairless Terrier vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the American Hairless Terrier series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone American Hairless Terrier shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or skin sunburn risk worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week American Hairless Terrier make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave American Hairless Terrier antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed American Hairless Terrier dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small dog.
Reset the American Hairless Terrier reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the American Hairless Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my American Hairless Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read American Hairless Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the American Hairless Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as skin sunburn risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
